riding-horse.summary: A brown chibi horse with a bridle, a saddle, and a blue pad. It is close to the mockup, but the eyes and the forelock are different.
strengths: The big head, the short stout legs, and the black hooves match the mockup.
The bridle, the saddle, the blue pad with yellow trim, and the stirrup read clearly.
The walk lifts each hoof and bends the knees.
issues: The eyes are too small and have black pupils. Make them larger with a dark brown iris and dark eyebrows, as in the mockup.
The mane stands up as a tall crest and falls down the neck in long locks. Make a short black forelock that sweeps over the forehead.
The mockup has a saddle bag on the flank. Add it.
The muzzle has a painted smile line that is wider than the mockup mouth. Make the mouth smaller.
riding-horse.next: Enlarge the eyes and give them a brown iris and eyebrows.

warhorse.summary: A grey armored chibi horse with a steel face plate, a red plume, a white mane, and a red caparison. It is the same character as the mockup, with clear differences in the armor and the body length.
strengths: The palette matches: grey coat, steel plate, red plume, red and gold cloth, white fetlock fur.
The white fetlock cuffs and the black hooves match the mockup.
The steel face plate reads as a different material from the coat.
issues: The face armor is a narrow center strip. Make a mask that frames the eyes, with cheek plates and a nose band, as in the mockup.
The body is too long for the head. Shorten the body and the neck to make the mockup's compact chibi shape.
The emblem is a small yellow star. Use a gold sun on a chest plate with gold trim.
The mockup has no saddle on top. Remove the saddle or make it smaller under the cloth.
warhorse.next: Rebuild the face armor as a mask that frames the eyes, with cheek plates.

pony.summary: A cream pony with a curly forelock, a brown patch, and brown hooves. It is noticeably less chibi than the mockup, and the face is different.
strengths: The cream coat, the brown back patch, and the brown hooves match the mockup.
The curly blond forelock is a good match.
The sprites read as a pony in every direction.
issues: The eyes are green and medium size. Make them very large and dark brown, with eyelashes and a big highlight.
The legs are long and the body is long. Shorten the legs and the body to make the round, stubby mockup shape.
The head is smaller than in the mockup. Make the head larger and rounder.
The mane hangs down the neck in braids. Make a short, fluffy mane as in the mockup.
The muzzle has a large pale snout with a smile line. Make a small muzzle with a small pink nose.
pony.next: Make the eyes very large, dark brown, and lashed.

donkey.summary: A grey chibi donkey with tall ears, a spiky tuft, blue eyes, and a light muzzle. It is the same character as the mockup, but the head is smaller and the stripes are different.
strengths: The tall ears with dark edges and the spiky black tuft read from every view.
The blue eyes match the mockup.
The tufted tail and the black hooves match.
issues: The head and the ears are smaller in relation to the body than in the mockup. Make the head and the ears larger, and the body shorter.
The stripes are three short dashes on the haunch. They look like scratch marks. Paint wider dark bands on the upper hind legs.
The muzzle and the chest are white. Make them warm cream.
The eyes are smaller than in the mockup and lack the brow shape. Enlarge them and add dark eyebrows.
donkey.next: Make the head and ears larger and the body shorter.

mule.summary: A brown chibi mule with a tan muzzle, a dark mane, a halter, and a pack saddle. It is the same character as the mockup, but the pack and the legs are different.
strengths: The brown coat, the tan muzzle, and the spiky dark mane match the mockup.
The halter and the rope read clearly.
The pack with a red blanket and a bedroll gives the role at 128 px.
issues: The pack is small. Make a tall load of stacked crates and a bedroll tied with rope, as in the mockup.
The cream fur cuffs above the hooves are not in the mockup. Remove them or make them a thin band.
The legs are longer than in the mockup. Shorten them and make the body more barrel-shaped.
The mockup has a rope coil around the neck. Add it.
mule.next: Make the pack a tall load of stacked crates and a bedroll with rope.

stag.summary: An orange chibi deer with antlers, a white chest, and black hooves. It is the same animal, but the antlers and the eyes are clearly different from the mockup.
strengths: The orange coat, the white chest, and the large pale-lined ears match the mockup.
The deer reads clearly in every sprite direction.
The walk is clean, and the hooves lift and land.
issues: The antlers are tall, narrow, and have few tines. Make wide, thick antlers that spread outward with many tines, as in the mockup.
The eyes are smaller than in the mockup. Make them very large and glossy, with a big highlight.
The mockup has a cream spot on the flank. Add it.
The legs are very thin and the hooves are small. Make the legs a little thicker and the hooves larger.
stag.next: Rebuild the antlers as a wide, thick crown with many tines.

elk.summary: A tan chibi deer with antlers and a dark brown neck ruff. It is the same animal, but the face, the antlers, and the legs are clearly different from the mockup.
strengths: The tan coat and the shaggy dark ruff match the mockup.
The cream belly and the black hooves match.
The walk is clean.
issues: The mouth is a very small smile and the nose is small. Make a wide grin and a large black ball nose, as in the mockup.
The antlers are tall and narrow. Make them shorter and spread them wider to the sides.
The legs are very thin. Make them stockier, as in the mockup.
The model looks like the stag with a new color. Make the head broader and the body heavier to give the elk its own shape.
elk.next: Give the face the wide grin and the large black nose of the mockup.

moose.summary: A dark brown chibi moose with light palm antlers, a hair tuft, a dewlap, and cream lower legs. The face expression and the antler size are different from the mockup.
strengths: The dark brown body, the light palm antlers, and the black tuft match the mockup palette.
The cream lower legs and the black hooves match.
The dewlap is a good moose detail.
issues: The mouth is a closed smile. The mockup has an open grin with a red mouth. Open the mouth and show the red inside.
The antlers are small and look like large ears. Make them much wider, so they spread far past the sides of the head.
The eyes are glossy black. Make them white with black pupils, as in the mockup.
The muzzle is small. Make it larger and more bulbous.
The legs are thin. Make them stockier.
moose.next: Open the mouth in a wide grin with a red inside.

goat.summary: A white chibi goat with golden horns, wide ears, brown eyes, and a brown flank spot. It is the same animal, but the head tuft, the beard, and the legs are clearly different.
strengths: The cream coat, the golden horns, the wide ears, and the brown eyes match the mockup.
The pink nose and the small smile match.
The brown flank spot and the black hooves match.
issues: The head tuft is a round knob. Make a swept forelock that curls forward, as in the mockup.
The model has a white beard. The mockup has no beard. Remove the beard and add the chest fluff.
The legs are long and thin. Make them shorter and stockier.
The horns stand up. Curve them back around the head, as in the mockup.
goat.next: Replace the knob with a swept forelock and remove the beard.

pack-goat.summary: A grey goat with curled horns and small red and tan bags. The body is slim and smooth, and the mockup goat is stocky and shaggy.
strengths: The ridged, curled horns match the mockup well.
The grey coat and the red and tan bag colors match.
The large brown eyes read at 128 px.
issues: The body is slim and the legs are long and thin, like a deer. Make the body stocky and the legs shorter and thicker.
The coat is smooth. Add the long shaggy grey hair on the neck, the chest, and the belly.
The bags are small. Make large saddlebags with brown straps across the chest and the belly.
The beard is white. Make it grey and shaggy.
The mockup has a visible smile. Add a mouth.
pack-goat.next: Make the body stocky with short thick legs and a shaggy coat.

sheep.summary: A white chibi sheep with a cream face, pink ears, and a woolly body. The wool, the eyes, and the legs are clearly different from the mockup.
strengths: The cream face, the blush, and the small smile read well.
The woolly round body reads as a sheep in every sprite direction.
The black hooves match.
issues: The wool is a rough, crumpled surface with dark specks. Make neat cream spiral curls, as in the mockup.
The legs are long and thin. Make them very short, so the sheep is a squat column.
The eyes are glossy black. Make them white with black pupils.
The nose is a brown oval. Make a small black triangle nose.
The wool on the head is a small cap. Cover the top and the sides of the head with curls.
sheep.next: Replace the rough wool with neat cream spiral curls.

cow.summary: A white chibi cow with black spots, gold horns, a pink muzzle, and a collar with a bell. It is the same character as the mockup, with clear differences in the patches and the legs.
strengths: The gold horns, the pink muzzle, and the collar with a gold bell match the mockup.
The black and white pattern reads at 128 px.
The tufted tail matches.
issues: The mockup has a black patch over one eye and the top of the head. Add it.
The legs are long. Shorten them for the stocky mockup shape.
The mockup has black spots on the legs and a pink udder. Add them.
The muzzle has a smile line. The mockup muzzle has only nostrils. Remove the line or make it very small.
cow.next: Add the black patch over one eye and the top of the head.

ox.summary: A brown chibi ox with cream horns, a pink muzzle, and a bead collar with a bell. It is the same character as the mockup, with clear differences in the horns and the harness.
strengths: The brown coat, the big eyes, and the cream horns match the mockup.
The bell gives the farm role.
The tufted tail and the black hooves match.
issues: The horns go out to the sides and are thin. Make thicker horns that curve up like a crescent.
The collar is on the neck. The mockup has a rope around the body with the bell. Move the rope to the chest and the body.
The muzzle is pink. Make it tan, as in the mockup.
The legs are long. Make them shorter for the stocky mockup shape.
ox.next: Make the horns thicker and curve them up like a crescent.

yak.summary: A shaggy brown chibi yak with cream horns, a fringe, and a tan face. It is the same character as the mockup, but the hair shape is different.
strengths: The cream horns, the fringe over the eyes, and the tan face match the mockup.
The long hair gives a clear yak silhouette in the sprites.
The black hooves match.
issues: The hair hangs as flat, straight strips like a curtain. Make thick, wavy clumps with varied length, as in the mockup.
The tan lower legs show below the hair. Lengthen the hair so it covers the legs down to the hooves.
The tail is long like a horse tail. Make a short fluffy tail.
The muzzle is cream. Make it tan with dark nostrils.
yak.next: Rebuild the hair as thick wavy clumps that cover the legs.

camel.summary: A tan chibi animal with lashed eyes, a hair tuft, and a striped blanket. It has no long curved neck and no clear hump, so it reads as a llama or a fawn, not a camel.
strengths: The tan coat, the lashed eyes, and the hair tuft match the mockup.
The knobby knees are a good camel detail.
The walk is clean.
issues: The head sits on a short neck. Make a long neck that curves up from the chest and holds the head forward.
There is no clear hump. Make a tall hump on the back and put the blanket over it.
The blanket is flat rainbow stripes. Make a red blanket with colorful rolled trim and tassels, as in the mockup.
The head is round like a fawn. Make a longer camel head with a large droopy muzzle.
The feet are pale hooves. Make wide brown pads.
camel.next: Add the long curved neck and a tall hump under the blanket.
